title: T4127 Payroll Deductions Formulas - 122nd Edition - Effective January 1, 2026 (HTML version)
author: Canada Revenue Agency, Government of Canada
role: Official federal administrative publication that states the 2026 Ontario amounts indexed under s 23 of the Taxation Act, 2007: Table 8.1 (Ontario income thresholds 53,891 / 107,785 / 150,000 / 220,000 and rates), Table 8.2 (Ontario basic personal amount 12,989, index rate 0.019, S2 300, surtax thresholds 5,818 / 7,446) and the Ontario factor S ($554 a dependant). Not an Ontario instrument; it is brought in for the indexed numbers only.

Nothing else altered.
